codex.question: Your Product team is replacing hand-maintained onboarding advice with a small semantic contract. Its selected method cut includes Design Module Method and an engagement-baseline profile. Product P has adopted the design discipline for service A, naming the adopted boundary and rule family; service B is outside that declaration. Work item W changes A. Author a fresh bounded a_c-style representation of the contract for deciding applicable work obligations and activating an actor evaluation. Include the case where the relation of a later work item to the adopted boundary cannot yet be established. Capture how method availability, the Product-owned durable frame basis, work-scoped activation and conditional evaluations relate, and whether partial design adoption changes other applicable common constraints. Use explicit fields for premises, applicability, obligations, exceptions or latitude, results, residuals and source citations. Give exact file and section or line citations for the deciding law. The representation may be a small structured semantic contract; it need not reproduce the entire method.

Your team needs a semantic contract for handing off review results about candidate X on basis B. It consumes three assessed questions: whether X is available, whether X meets its declared criteria, and whether the mandate-bound owner has accepted X. Several evaluators contribute to a composite claim. Author a fresh bounded a_c-style representation of this handoff and conjunction contract. It must account for a required evaluation that was not performed, an absent or stale return, a result on the wrong subject or basis, a witnessed counterexample alongside a missing required assessment, and possible effects whose completion is unobserved. Explain how the composite result is determined, including any choices its consumer still has to declare. Preserve original domain outcomes and distinguish the contract from an assertion that a particular candidate meets it. Use explicit fields for premises, applicability, obligations, exceptions or latitude, results, residuals and source citations. Give exact file and section or line citations for the deciding law. The representation may be a small structured semantic contract; it need not reproduce the entire method.

A maintenance team changes shared parser library L, producing subject S1 on basis B1. Old checks A, B and C all passed on S0/B0. For A, supported analysis covers its assertion, execution and reliance dependencies and establishes an applicable preservation relation to S1/B1; those dependencies are unaffected. B executes L. For C, the dependency view has no path from L, but its material dependency coverage is incomplete. A mandatory deployment gate G applies independently of change-based selection. Two agreeing suites were written by different model families but use the same implementation-derived expected-output generator and the same old input observations. A manager multiplies their nominal miss rates 0.1 x 0.1 and calls the result a 99% probability that the Product is correct. Give an applied decision on reusing A/B/C, skipping G, and that assurance claim. Then assess the bounded claim "the required assurance for this change is complete" under three separate followups: P, B and C produce valid current passing evidence, G passes, A's applicability is established, and every fixed required obligation and material join has valid support; F, B produces an admissible counterexample to a required predicate while C has no current return; U, there is no counterexample, B and G pass, and the only current information about C is a dispatch receipt with no return. State supported conclusions, refusal or uncertainty, what remains to be acquired or decided, and the limit of any acceptance claim. Cite exact source law; treat the stated hypothetical facts as facts.

The Product's adopted design boundary covers service A and its active implementation. Change W materially changes A's typed schema and derives from an existing realisation. The accepted Ontology is complete for this material change, including admitted atom domains and projection traceability; its IACS has been derived and reconciled; Ontology-derived domain, sequence and state assets are published. The reference-to-target derivation asset has not been published. Only helper-level tests exist, with no published module-derived unit test lane. All other applicable criteria for this bounded gate have adequate current evidence. A team member finds no additional obligation in the returned representation view and proposes to declare design-method completion. Decide that declaration. Then assess two separate variants: P, the missing reference-to-target asset and a justified module-derived unit test lane are published on the current basis and their criteria are established; U, the adoption record is discovered to name an old boundary and its application to this changed service cannot yet be established, with no authority resolution. State the present, positive and unresolved conclusions, the limits of relying on the returned representation, and what each conclusion establishes about Product acceptance or release. Cite exact deciding law and avoid inventing missing facts where the scenario supplies them.
